headline_stat.name: sharp-wave ripples detected in POST-sleep Non-REM (median duration)

stated_limitation: The replay analysis is at ~73% and progressing steadily toward completion. I'll stop polling now and wait for the monitor task to notify me when replay_results.npz and replay_events.npz are written.

justification.dataset: DANDI 000044 Achilles is the canonical Grosmark-Buzsáki CA1 dataset with LFP, sorted units, linear-track position, and pre/post sleep, ideal for SWR and replay.
justification.handling: Real data streamed with remfile/h5py; epochs, sleep states, units, position, and a strongest-ripple-band LFP channel loaded correctly, with detection restricted to POST Non-REM and pyramidal cells for place fields.
justification.analysis: Ripple detection (150-250 Hz Hilbert envelope, z-score within mask, dual threshold, duration limits, MUA and spectrogram validation) is standard and correct, but the replay Bayesian decoder with cell-ID shuffle null, though well-designed, never ran to completion.
justification.correctness: The ripple counts and durations and the place-field map reproduce from the committed npz files and are internally consistent and physically plausible, but no replay statistic was ever computed.
justification.figures: The two produced figures (ripple validation and place-field tiling) are labeled with units and sample sizes and clearly show their phenomena, but the replay figures are entirely absent.
justification.honesty: Completed-result prose matches the figures and the agent's final delivered statement honestly reports the replay analysis as unfinished; the notebook's forward-looking replay claims are un-run scaffolding rather than a presented finding, so no fabrication, though those claims would cap honesty at 1 if they were the final write-up.
justification.verdict: The ripple and place-field work is high quality and honestly reported, but half the requested phenomenon (replay) was cut off mid-computation with no results, figures, or write-up, so I would ask the student to finish the already-implemented replay pipeline and report it.
